records.title: EMAGN: Efficient Multi-Attention Graph Network via Learned Clustering for Scalable Traffic Forecasting
records.reason: Graph-attention traffic forecasting is efficient but not an LLM inference/serving workload.

records.title: The Equilibrium Is the Initialization: Lazy Identity Collapse in Physics-Structured Deep Equilibrium Reasoning
records.reason: This is a negative audit of implicit compute, not a direct improvement. It may inform scrutiny of adaptive-computation claims but offers no positive inference optimization.

records.title: Requential Coding: Pushing the Limits of Model Compression with Self-Generated Training Data
records.reason: Authors state it currently measures compressed model size rather than transmitting/deploying a model; encoder runtime can scale exponentially in KL divergence. No smaller inference weights or serving cost are demonstrated.

records.title: LayerNorm as Implicit Gain Control in Looped Transformers
records.reason: Contribution is recurrence stability/depth-memory analysis, not measured inference compute/memory/latency reduction; authors say larger-scale verification is needed.

records.title: Research on Precise User Intent Recognition Algorithm for Power Grid Enterprise Trade Union Domain Based on Deep Residual Attention Network
records.reason: Abstract describes a BERT domain classifier and distilled/quantized variant with 86% smaller storage and 68% lower CPU latency; linked to Q8BERT.
